templateListing.fact: GET /templates params: type_identifier (WITHOUT 't-' prefix, must be in TEMPLATE_FOR_TYPES else code 2), exclude_type_identifiers (array/JSON string, same whitelist), hide_onboarding_v2_templates ('true'), item_type/item_id, intake_template_id, condition_id
Response {default:[...], saved:[...]} both serialized with TemplateSerializer minimal:true (no widgets/forms/configurations/current_user_access_type)

default = Template.active, template_type 'default', type_identifier && ['t-<x>'], company_id = workspace OR company_id NULL (global) unless company config hide_default_templates; ordered updated_at desc

saved = get_allowed_templates_object(user) [active, company_id in allowed companies OR NULL] then template_type in (custom,dynamic), template_for not in (module,custom_search), rfi only created_at >= 2022-07-30
Procol employee: saved list scoped to Current.workspace only (no access filter)
Non-super-admin: t-rfi templates always filtered by access lists; t-trade templates filtered by access lists only if company config enable_template_access_filtering == true
exclude 'site_visit' auto-appended when workspace is vendor_onboarding_version_v3
GET /templates/:id -> Template.get_authorized_template_with_id: active only else 4; other company (not procol employee) -> 2; rfi needs access list -> 2; trade + template_access_filtering -> 5

GET /templates/:id response: TemplateSerializer full: id, name, template_for (type_identifier suffixes), template_type, widgets (trade only: inline_components/global_price_components with currency prefix + widget_precision override), forms (rfi/intake only, sorted by order), configurations, mapped_widgets, global_mapped_widgets (Widget rows via template_widget_mappings for custom, by order_type for default), order_configs, shared_with, sharing_note, currency_configuration, template_mapping_uuid, terms_and_conditions(+_structured), allow_currency_change_intake, linked_template_uuid
Template name must be unique per (type_identifier overlap, company, template_type, order_type) among active: 'Template name has already been taken'

Event stage links template by params['template_id']: trade.template_id set, template.configurations merged into trade.config, template_type_identifier copied, currency_config from other_details. Template.find_by_id has NO active/company check here (nil template would raise NoMethodError -> 500)

The widgets actually stored on the event come from the REQUEST body params[:widgets] (not re-read from template) - backend adds serial_number/rank/best_price/gross_total/status/action widgets and overwrites precision

structure.fact: templates table: id, name, template_for int enum, template_type int enum (default/custom/dynamic), order_type (buy/sell), status (0 in_active,1 active), type_identifier varchar[], widgets json, configurations json, other_details jsonb, template_mappings jsonb, terms_and_conditions jsonb, company_id (NULL=global), user_id
TRADE templates: widgets = {inline_components:[widget], global_price_components:[widget]}; inline = per line-item column, global = per-bid (header) field
Widget object: {name, key_attribute (unique within template), input_type, widget_type (default|custom), configuration:{...}, column_group, validation:{type,target_widget}}

RFI/INTAKE/onboarding templates: widgets = array of forms {order:int, name:string, config:{type:string}, page_headers:[widget] (creator/question), page_response_headers:[widget] (answers), aggregate_level_questions}; v3 onboarding keeps fields in page_headers

Allowed configuration keys (CONFIGURATION_OPTIONS): is_replicable, field_type, mode_type, is_negotiable, priority, is_removable, is_required, dropdown_data, cell_options, allow_failed_validation_submit, allow_failed_validation_refresh, allow_multi_response
field_type in WIDGET_FIELD_TYPES = creator (buyer fills) | participant (vendor fills) | formula; mode_type = write | read | hidden

Other configuration keys read by backend: input_group (price|amount|quantity|number; price/amount get currency prefix), prefix, suffix (unit on quantity/price), precision (overridden by company widget_precision / trade config widget_precision), formula, dropdown_data (URL with type=...), dropdown_options, data_source, is_buyer_editable, hide_in_product_sheet, freeze_widget, round_off_type, show_in_original_currency, options

Template-level configurations: conditional_block (dependency rules), section_grouping_key, applied_filters, auto_fetch_from_rfp_widget_keys, clara_condition, template_for_trade_type (freight), validation_widgets_configuration, section_wise_scoring_enabled

Global widget catalogue: widgets table (name, key_attribute, input_type int enum, widget_type, config json, category inline/global, type_identifier[] for order type, company_id); mapped to custom templates via template_widget_mappings (template_id, widget_id, status). New templates auto-map custom_text_widget_participant, custom_text_widget_creator, floor_quantity, ceil_price, tick_size, floor_price
Dropdown option values live in widget_data_mappings (key = widget key_attribute, value, configuration.display_value, company_id, status)

Filled line items are stored as trade_products (quantity, price, unit_id, validations{default:{ceil_price,tick_size,tick_size_percentage,floor_quantity,floor_price},custom}, meta_data{postfix,...}, other_details custom keys); raw sheet in trade_requests.meta_data
Vendor technical answers: template_responses (data jsonb, widgets json, item_type/item_id, template_id, company_id, status, approval_status) with form_responses -> form_page_responses.response_data

buyer_hub (delivery location); buyer_hub not allowed as custom widget

units.fact: units table: id, name, symbol (downcased before_save, indexed), conversion_factor float default 1.0 (rounded to 2dp), base_unit_id -> units.id, status 0 in_active/1 active, company_id (NULL = global Procol unit), user_id
Company#units == Unit.for_company(company_id): active company units OR active global units, cached 1 day under 'units_for_company_id#<id>' and 'procol_units'
If company config material_codification == true OR get_company_only_units == true -> ONLY company_id = <company> units (global units excluded)
Unit conversion: base_unit_id + conversion_factor (>0); used in bulk upload (base unit resolved by LOWER(symbol) among company+global). No conversion is applied in the line-item unit check

Product units: product_units (product_id, unit_id, status) - Product has_many units through product_units (active only, ANY company incl. global); ProductUnit rejects inactive unit or unit.company_id != product.company_id with 'Unit not found'; global units allowed
UnitSerializer returns symbol = display_unit (symbol upcased if < 3 chars, else titleize), NOT the raw symbol; ProductSerializer has_many units via UnitSerializer

Line-item unit on event create = creator_quantity.configuration.suffix, else product.unit_type; downcased and looked up by exact symbol in Current.workspace.units; trade_product gets unit_id/unit_symbol/display_unit
GET /units, /units/all, /units/autocomplete_search all return Unit.active.for_company(workspace) (same filter as the event check)
Units editable only if company-owned (find_unit where company_id = workspace)

Excel/BOQ uploads auto-create missing units for the company via Unit.insert_all! (skips callbacks: no cache invalidation, no validations); BOQ path always checks company+global ignoring company-only config
ERP integrations (products, PR worker) find_or_initialize unit by downcased symbol in Unit.for_company and create a company unit if missing

RFQ stage from event-group line items resolves unit by Unit.for_company(company).find_by(symbol: egli.unit_symbol.downcase); egli.unit_symbol comes from precomputed_data.creator_fields.creator_quantity.unitSymbol
Intake products: unit_id from creator_quantity.configuration.suffix via workspace.units index_by symbol; missing -> 495

No text 'not available' / available_units / allowed_units / company_units exists for units in app, lib or en-IN.yml; the only unit-availability failure texts are 495 'Unit not found' / 'The unit X is not present', excel 'Invalid Unit', ProductUnit 'Unit not found', bulk 'Base unit with symbol X not found'

Unit#products is has_and_belongs_to_many (default join table products_units) while the real join table is product_units - Unit#products likely broken (unverified: no products_units table in schema.rb)
Product#add_units uses product_units.unscoped (drops product_id scope) - reactivation query can touch other products' product_units rows (Rails unscoped semantics; unverified at runtime)

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H1 (strongest): company 47053 has get_company_only_units or material_codification = true, so Company#units excludes global units; a product/line item whose unit is a GLOBAL unit (e.g. 'nos','kg') fails with 495 'The unit X is not present' even though the product lists that unit (product.units is not company-filtered)
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT config_key, modifications->>'value' AS value, status FROM custom_configurations WHERE item_type='Company' AND item_id=47053 AND config_key IN ('get_company_only_units','material_codification'); SELECT config_key, defaults->>'value', company_id FROM master_configurations WHERE config_key IN ('get_company_only_units','material_codification') AND status=1;

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H1b: products of 47053 linked to global units that are not available once company-only mode is on
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.product_code, u.id unit_id, u.symbol, u.company_id FROM products p JOIN product_units pu ON pu.product_id=p.id AND pu.status=1 JOIN units u ON u.id=pu.unit_id AND u.status=1 WHERE p.company_id=47053 AND u.company_id IS NULL;

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H2: symbol vs display mismatch - API returns display_unit (titleize turns '-' and '_' into spaces), UI sends it back as suffix, backend downcases and compares to raw symbol -> 'sq ft' != 'sq-ft' -> 495 (frontend echo behaviour unverified)
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT id, name, symbol, company_id FROM units WHERE status=1 AND (company_id=47053 OR company_id IS NULL) AND (symbol ~ '[-_]' OR symbol ~ '_id$' OR symbol <> lower(symbol));

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H3: the unit the UI sends is a unit NAME (e.g. 'Numbers') not the symbol ('nos'); lookup is by symbol only
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT id, name, symbol, company_id FROM units WHERE status=1 AND (company_id=47053 OR company_id IS NULL) AND lower(name) <> symbol ORDER BY company_id NULLS FIRST, symbol;

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H4: the unit exists only as INACTIVE (deactivated via /units/:id/deactivate) or under a different company
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT id, name, symbol, status, company_id FROM units WHERE lower(symbol)=lower('<suffix sent>') ORDER BY company_id NULLS FIRST;

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H5: PR-linked line items where PR uom text differs from unit symbol -> 559 rather than 495
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT pri.id, pri.data->>'uom' AS pr_uom, pri.unit_id, u.symbol FROM purchase_request_items pri LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id=pri.unit_id JOIN purchase_requests pr ON pr.id=pri.purchase_request_id WHERE pr.company_id=47053 AND lower(pri.data->>'uom') <> coalesce(u.symbol,'') LIMIT 200;

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H6: default creator_quantity suffix 'KG' left in template/line item while 47053 (company-only mode) has no company unit 'kg'
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT id, name, (widgets::jsonb->'inline_components') @> '[{"key_attribute":"creator_quantity"}]' has_qty, jsonb_path_query_array(widgets::jsonb, '$.inline_components[*] ? (@.key_attribute=="creator_quantity").configuration.suffix') qty_suffix FROM templates WHERE company_id=47053 AND status=1 AND type_identifier && ARRAY['t-trade']::varchar[];

gmmccoHypotheses.hypothesis: H7 (unverified): stale unit cache - Unit.for_company caches relations 1 day in redis; Unit.insert_all! (excel/BOQ auto-create) skips invalidate_cache. Only matters if the cached value is materialised
gmmccoHypotheses.howToConfirmWithSql: SELECT id, symbol, company_id, created_at FROM units WHERE company_id=47053 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20;  -- then retry after cache expiry / redis DEL units_for_company_id#47053
